questions.q: What is the main purpose of Carl Richards' One-Page Financial Plan?
a: Help readers commit to a personal finance process
questions.why: It is designed to help people stick to a personal finance process.

questions.q: Which example illustrates the need for flexible financial goals?
questions.why: The text compares mobile phone bills to show goals should allow room for surprises.

questions.q: How does Richards suggest making budgeting more enjoyable?
questions.why: He recommends viewing budgeting as a game to track money against goals.

questions.q: What strategy does Richards recommend for paying off debt?
a: Pay the highest interest rate first
questions.why: He advises paying the debt with the highest interest rate first.

questions.q: Why does Richards call debt repayment an investment?
questions.why: He frames debt repayment as investing in your future self.
